title: Rig Work Event
description:
Append-only event record for ADR-local progress ledgers (progress.jsonl).

Note: docs/schemas/work-stream-event.schema.json covers worktree lifecycle events
(worktree_moved, worktree_move_blocked). This schema covers ADR implementation
progress events. The two schemas are intentionally separate: worktree events are
infrastructure; work progress events are coordination state.

event_id.description: UUID or deterministic slug uniquely identifying this event.

worker.description: Agent or user name/slug that appended this event.

task_id.description: The ADR task ID this event belongs to.

sprint_id.description: Sprint ID if this event is sprint-specific.

mission_id.description: Mission ID if this event is mission-specific.

paths.description: File paths relevant to this event.

checks.description: Check commands run or to be run.

out_of_scope_findings.description: Observations outside current mission or sprint scope. Must not expand scope or authorize edits outside allowed_paths.

research_artifacts.description: List of research artifacts produced (for sprint_research_completed events).

patch_batch_id.description: Patch batch ID for patch batch events.

precheck_passed.description: Whether git apply --check passed (for patch_batch_prechecked events).

planned_files.description: Files planned to be changed (for patch_batch_planned events).

protected_paths_touched.description: Protected paths that were touched (must be empty for successful application).

patch_batches_applied.description: List of patch batch IDs applied (for handoff events).

safe_to_apply.description: Whether the patch is safe to apply (for patch_batch_merge_friendly_checked events).

patch_path.description: Path to the patch file (for patch_batch_merge_friendly_checked events).

patch_hash.description: SHA256 hash of patch content (truncated, for patch_batch_merge_friendly_checked events).

checked_worktree_count.description: Number of worktrees checked (for patch_batch_merge_friendly_checked events).

overlapping_files.description: Files that overlap between patch and dirty worktree files (for patch_batch_merge_friendly_checked events).

dirty_worktrees.description: Worktrees with dirty/staged changes (for patch_batch_merge_friendly_checked events).

blocked_reasons.description: Reasons the patch was blocked (for patch_batch_merge_friendly_checked events).

target.description: Target branch for promotion (for preproduction_promotion_* events).

source_branch.description: Source branch being promoted (for preproduction_promotion_* events).

source_head.description: Source branch HEAD commit (for preproduction_promotion_* events).

gate_results.description: Results of all Rite of Deterministic Passage gates (for preproduction_promotion_* events).

blocking_gates_failures.description: Number of blocking gate failures (for preproduction_promotion_* events).

all_gates_passed.description: Whether all gates passed (for preproduction_promotion_* events).
